meta.purpose: Everything on this site that a reviewer should look at before trusting it. Grouped by severity, not by topic. Each row names what was expected, what was found, and where to check it.

severity_key.high: Affects whether the site can earn at all, or whether a claim on the site is currently wrong.
severity_key.medium: Affects usefulness or discoverability, not correctness.

flags.title: Every submitted path code is 9 characters; every ASIN observed on arrival is 10
flags.expected: An Amazon Standard Identification Number is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier.
flags.found: All five submitted codes (B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV, B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj) are 9 characters and contain lowercase letters. All five destinations resolve and carry 10-character uppercase ASINs: B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH, B0DHZTCNR5, B0DZFD6R9Z.
flags.reading: The submitted codes are short-link slugs rather than product ASINs. An earlier register on this repository mistakenly placed them in the intended ASIN column. That error is corrected here by keeping intended_asin null until the account owner confirms each ASIN.
to_check: Open each supplied link and compare the /dp/ segment to the 9-character code in the submitted link
flags.impact: The 'intended_asin' field is null for all five rather than filled with the slug. Intended and observed identifiers are never merged.
flags.blocks: nothing — but it explains why the intended ASIN column stays blank until account-owner confirmation

flags.title: No supplied link showed the tracking tag on arrival
flags.expected: Special Links must use the Associates ID assigned to the account (SRC-02).
flags.found: None of the five resolving links presented a tag parameter on the page that was reached. The tracking ID shopnow047c-20 was supplied in the brief but was not observed in any resolved URL.
flags.reading: This is not proof the links are untagged — the tag may be applied server-side by the short-link service after the arrival page was captured. It is proof that this build could not confirm attribution, which is different.
to_check: One test click from the owner's device, then check the Associates click report for shopnow047c-20
flags.impact: No page claims a click will be attributed. Every product page states that attribution is unconfirmed.

flags.title: Compliance status of the short links is unresolved, not disproven
flags.expected: Special Links may be created by the Associate or supplied by Amazon, and must include the tag as a URL parameter (SRC-02).
flags.found: The supplied links are of the form link.amazon/<code>. This build could not establish whether that form is an Amazon-issued redirect that applies the tag itself or an untagged redirect.
flags.reading: An earlier version of this site implied the links were unusable. That was an overstatement. The honest status is unresolved until tested in the enrolled Associates workflow.
flags.impact: The submitted links remain recorded in the register alongside the observed listing URLs; all outbound Amazon product links are marked sponsored.

flags.title: P-04 resolved on re-verification after earlier /checkpoint/continue blocks (intermittent redirects)
flags.expected: A short link resolves reliably to its product page on every request.
flags.found: https://link.amazon/B0c8moW59 returned Amazon's /checkpoint/continue interstitial on three earlier automated requests, then resolved cleanly on two independent re-verifications on 2026-11-20 to ASIN B0DHZTCNR5 (ThermoMaven 1 Sec Professional Digital Meat Thermometer). P-01 also hit a continuity page once before resolving.
flags.reading: Intermittent bot-interstitial gating on link.amazon redirects means automated checks can fail unpredictably and shoppers may encounter extra redirect friction compared with validated direct /dp/ Special Links.
to_check: Open https://link.amazon/B0c8moW59 in an ordinary browser and compare the destination against B0DHZTCNR5
flags.impact: P-04 is now identified and published in the Meat Thermometers category alongside P-05, while both the earlier failure and the later resolution remain dated in its record.
flags.blocks: nothing — P-04 is live, though replacing short links with validated Special Links (S-02) remains recommended

flags.title: No price, rating, review count or stock status — by rule, not by omission
flags.expected: Program Policies §2(b) permit price and availability only where Amazon serves the data or it arrives via Creators API / PA API.
flags.reading: This is the single most common failure in affiliate sites and the most common way an Associates account is closed. Empty is the compliant state.
flags.impact: A machine check in tools/check.py fails the build if a currency figure, a star rating, a review count or a stock phrase is introduced.
flags.blocks: nothing — the site is deliberately usable without them

flags.title: No author, and no basis for editorial authority
flags.expected: A publication a reader can assess.
flags.found: No byline. No first-hand testing. No credential.
flags.reading: The guides are therefore written as checklists of buyer questions and official public references, which is what can honestly be produced without hands-on access to the products. That is a real limitation on how much a reader should take from them.
flags.impact: Every guide says plainly that no product was tested.

flags.title: Every photograph on this site is AI-generated editorial illustration
flags.expected: Product photography would normally be real.
flags.found: All ten editorial images were generated for this publication. None is a photograph of a submitted product. Each is labelled where it appears.
flags.reading: Unlabelled AI imagery next to a buy button is a deceptive practice risk. Labelled, it is an editorial convention. The line between the two is thin, which is why every use carries a visible caption.
to_check: review/images.html lists every asset, its prompt intent, and every page it appears on
flags.impact: Captions read 'Editorial illustration. It is not a photograph of this product'.
flags.blocks: nothing, but it caps how persuasive a product page can be

flags.title: Multiple parallel editions coexist in the repository tree
flags.expected: One canonical publication with one URL layout.
flags.found: Several parallel agent sessions contributed to main before this integration pass. Crisp & Counter owns the root index, sitemap.xml, feed.xml and structured subdirectories; earlier parallel-edition files (such as crisp/, dashboard.html, products.html and standalone guides) remain preserved in the tree rather than deleted.
flags.reading: Nothing from another session was silently deleted. The front page, primary navigation, sitemap and RSS feed point exclusively to the canonical Crisp & Counter build so search engines see one coherent publication.
flags.impact: Consolidating or archiving the legacy parallel files is logged as decision S-13 on the Suggestions page for human approval.

flags.title: The site lives on a repository subpath, which changes how every link must be written
flags.expected: A site at a domain root can use /guides/ style links.
flags.found: GitHub Pages serves this repository at /Affil1/. A root-absolute link such as href="/about/" resolves to karagemop466-tech.github.io/about/ and 404s.
flags.reading: This is the single most common way a project-pages site ships broken. Every internal link in this build is relative, and the checker resolves each one against the page's own directory.
flags.impact: tools/check.py fails the build on any root-absolute internal href.

flags.title: Analytics exists in the code but is switched off
flags.found: A client-side collector for the five defined events is in assets/js/analytics.js (and a self-hosted Node endpoint exists in server/collect.js). The client sends nothing until window.CC_ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT is configured, and no backend host is deployed on static GitHub Pages.
flags.reading: Shipping a live analytics beacon without a published privacy notice and deployed first-party host would be worse than shipping none. It is deliberately inert.
flags.impact: The site currently measures nothing. Every traffic statement on this site says so.
flags.blocks: evidence-based iteration, and it is flagged as such

flags.title: Seller Central's ASIN length help article sits behind a sign-in wall
flags.expected: A public Seller Central citation stating that an ASIN is 10 characters.
flags.found: sellercentral.amazon.com help pages return a sign-in wall. Amazon's public Selling Partner API Catalog Items reference (SRC-08) confirms ASIN as the catalog identifier, while the 9-vs-10 character comparison is presented directly as an observation of this register's five links.
flags.reading: Rather than cite a third-party blog as though it were Amazon, we cite SRC-08 for the ASIN concept and report the exact character counts observed on all five submitted vs. resolved links.
flags.impact: No page cites a third-party blog as an official Amazon policy source.

flags.title: USDA food-safety temperatures are verified; appliance-specific cook times remain unverified
flags.expected: Food-safety guidance must come from an official public-health authority, and cook-time claims require testing.
flags.found: On 2026-11-20, both the USDA FSIS Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart (SRC-06) and USDA FSIS Food Thermometers factsheet (SRC-07) were retrieved directly and verified. Earlier builds could not complete a TLS connection to USDA; that restriction is cleared. However, no air fryer or thermometer on this site has been physically tested.
flags.reading: Safe minimum internal temperatures (145°F whole cuts with 3-min rest, 160°F ground meats/eggs, 165°F poultry and leftovers) are published with official USDA citations. Model-specific cook times and doneness presets are still omitted.
flags.impact: The thermometer and hosting guides cite exact USDA FSIS temperatures while making zero untested appliance-time claims.

flags.title: Commission rates are blank
flags.expected: A revenue model needs a rate.
flags.found: The rate card is behind an Associates sign-in and was not supplied.
flags.reading: Copying a rate from a blog would produce a number with a false provenance. No conversion score and no revenue forecast appears anywhere on this site.
flags.impact: The campaign ledger is empty and says why.

flags.title: The campaign ledger is empty
flags.reading: An empty ledger with a defined schema is the correct starting state. A populated one would have required inventing numbers.
flags.impact: The ledger shows its columns and states the provenance rule.

flags.title: Two of five products (P-04 and P-05) are Meat Thermometers, not Air Fryers
flags.expected: Clarity on how the five links split across Amazon categories.
flags.found: Category path on arrival for P-04 (ThermoMaven B0DHZTCNR5) and P-05 (CHEF iQ Sense B0DZFD6R9Z): Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Kitchen Utensils & Gadgets > Thermometers & Timers > Meat. P-01, P-02 and P-03 sit under Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers.
flags.reading: Not an error in the links — the five products form a coherent two-category kitchen set (3 Air Fryers + 2 Meat Thermometers). Treating P-04 or P-05 as air fryers would be wrong.
flags.impact: The site organizes the catalogue into two dedicated categories (Air Fryers and Meat Thermometers) with separate category pages and tailored guides.
